title: Stainless steel double wall tumblers
text: Stainless steel double wall tumblers. These work great.  I purchased two... I keep water in one all day - rinse it out-while it's drying thoroughly I use the other... to help prevent rusting that does occur sometimes at the seams of these types of thermal tumblers. NONE so far with these - but as I said, I careful clean and use them. NO DISHWASHER - even it says they can.  I will say I have filled one with ice added a little water and then used out of a hot car ALL day.  There was still ice in the glass after more than 9 hours.  That is impressive to me.  They did come with little cloth sleeves.. I was initially confused by this as these tumbles are not supposed to "sweat"... and they do not sweat!  So... I am thinking the sleeves are an "easy" grip thing and also helps it to be stable in cup holder.  The plastic tops have rubber like gaskets and a slide opening.  The slide doesn't really stop water from pouring out - but it does slow the process.  It will keep foreign objects out of your water!  :)  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.. and I did wait to use these for a while to be able to share actual use experience.  I hope this info was helpful to you in making your decision as that's the whole reason I bother to write unbiased, uncompensated reviews!
